origin: an invented project brief in flowing prose: no bullets, one or two requirements inside each paragraph. Two statements in one paragraph are a known limit of 'one block is one requirement' (D3), marked known_limit

requirements.start: Patients must be able to book, move and cancel their own appointments online
Every patient gets a text message the evening before an appointment
Receptionists need one screen that shows a day's appointments
Clinic managers need a monthly report of missed appointments
every time a staff member opens a patient record
During the evening peak, between 17:00 and 20:00

not_requirements: We have not decided on a payment step. Fees stay at the desk for now.
Harbour Clinics runs eleven small clinics

clarifications.anchor: We have not decided on a payment step.
